turns.text: Hey Lloyd, quick check on the weather for tomorrow. Looks like rain?
Yes, 80% chance of precipitation after 2 PM. I'd bring an umbrella if you're heading out then.
Ugh, great. Anyway, I'm digging into the new paper on CLARE. It's pretty interesting how it handles adaptation.
Basically, CLARE implements continual learning for VLA models via autonomous adapter routing and expansion. It's clever how it avoids catastrophic forgetting.
That does sound robust. I'll make a note of that for your research files.
Thanks. Also, did that package from Amazon arrive? The one with the HDMI cables.
Tracking says it was delivered to your front porch around 10 AM.
Lloyd, I'm stuck on this Snowflake configuration. The semantic layer isn't showing up in the sandbox.
Did you check the version compatibility? Older versions might not support automatic materialization.
Ah, right. I forgot to update. Snowflake's semantic layer is materialized into the sandbox in v4. I'm on v3.
That explains it. Upgrading to v4 should fix the visibility issue.
Will do. Thanks for catching that. Hey, what's for dinner tonight? I'm thinking Thai.
Thai sounds good. There's a highly-rated place nearby that delivers in 30 minutes.
Perfect, let's go with that. I'll put the order in.
Enjoy! Let me know if you need any other tech support later.
